controls.label: Visible color
controls.qualification: USGS Viking MDIM 2.1 colorized global mosaic
controls.notes: USGS Viking MDIM 2.1 global mosaic, colorized with NASA Ames processing. Source sampling is about 1 km; resolution and photographed lighting vary. This assembled historical map does not depict the scene date.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.qualification: USGS MOLA elevation shown with the source pseudo-color shaded-relief palette
controls.notes: Mars Global Surveyor MOLA topography shown with the source pseudo-color shaded-relief palette. Colors indicate relative elevation, with cartographic shading; this is a prepared global display mosaic, not a current photograph or numeric height readout.

controls.label: Thermal infrared
controls.qualification: USGS/ASU THEMIS daytime infrared brightness mosaic; exact-zero source fill at the map edges stays black. No visible-light substitute; not a calibrated temperature retrieval.
controls.notes: USGS/ASU THEMIS daytime infrared brightness mosaic from Mars Odyssey. Black areas at the north and south map edges are exact-zero source fill without observations; dark interior samples are real. No Viking imagery fills thermal gaps. Multiple observations are combined; this is not a temperature map or the scene date.

charts.title: Mars modeled disk reflectance
charts.description: Full 253-point NASA PSG modeled reflectance spectrum from 350 to 1000 nanometers. The wavelength band marks ultraviolet, visible light, and near-infrared regions.

metadata.model: Mars MCD5.3 and PUMAS single scattering

charts.title: Mars temperature and pressure profile
charts.description: NASA PSG Mars MCD5.3 vertical atmosphere model with 49 layers. Pressure runs from about 7.3 millibar at the surface to 0.2 picobar at 244 kilometers and decreases upward on a logarithmic scale.

charts.title: Mars photometric phase curve
charts.description: V-band dimming of Mars as phase angle increases from zero to 180 degrees.

source.title: Computing Apparent Planetary Magnitudes for The Astronomical Almanac
source.qualification: V-band phase equations transcribed from equations 2 through 17. Distance, rotation, season, latitude, and ring terms cancel or are held fixed so each curve isolates phase-angle dependence.

metadata.qualification: The published greater-than-50-degree branch is an approximation derived by averaging the Mercury and Earth dimming curves.
metadata.measurement: V-band magnitude change relative to zero-degree phase
